permissions.name: android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE
permissions.title: 读取电话状态
permissions.advice: 常被用于取 IMEI；仅做统计则无必要申请

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
permissions.title: 精确位置
permissions.advice: 对照《必要个人信息范围规定》，非地图/出行类一般非必要

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
permissions.title: 粗略位置
permissions.advice: 确认业务确需位置；否则移除

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_CONTACTS
permissions.title: 读取通讯录
permissions.advice: 敏感个人信息，须明确告知用途并单独同意

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
permissions.title: 读取外部存储
permissions.advice: 优先用分区存储/SAF，减少全盘读取权限

permissions.name: android.permission.CAMERA
permissions.title: 相机
permissions.advice: 须在使用场景前申请，避免启动即申请

permissions.name: android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO
permissions.title: 录音
permissions.advice: 敏感权限，须场景化申请并明确告知

permissions.name: android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES
permissions.title: 查询全部应用
permissions.advice: Google/应用市场严格管控；非必要必须移除，改用 <queries>
